summary: All seven frames captured with sig prefix v-today- and diffed both numerically (sigdiff) and by pixel (banded whole-image diff plus side-by-side crops read as images). Much of the implementer's report holds up under measurement: the D063 Gaussian work and the D064 `r=` fix are real — I sampled the moon and its bloom across the disc on Today Home and design/app agree within 2/255 at every sample; Today Home diffs at 3,876 px over 12/255 and every one of those pixels is circle- or glyph-edge antialiasing (I traced a dot edge device-pixel by device-pixel: design 32, app 19, Δ13, one pixel wide). Today Home III is clean apart from the signature name; the quote mark now lands at 28,187,16,12, exactly the frame. Score Detail's night header is right (~250 px, stars and the water glint painted and within 5/255). Score Detail Moves and Ranks pair element for element once the pager's x offset is removed — the "you're here" pill, the four rank rows, the footer icons and captions all land on the canvas's numbers. I also checked the F20 failure class: /score reached the designed way (tapping "Recovery score" on Today) is pixel-identical to /score reached by URL, 0 px difference, so no duplicate-gradient-id defect there. What the report missed or understated is on page two of Today and in the score sheet's date formatting: the "This week" card picks its lesson by calendar day where three independent canvas numbers say it should pick by curriculum progress; frame #59's own composition is unreachable in the app; the score sheet's dates are locale-dependent and rendered in the wrong order under the capture host's own locale; and the Moves ledger was written off as unmatchable account data when four of its five rows are in fact seedable.

findings.frame: #59 Today Home II / #60 Today Home Task
findings.element: the "This week" card's title and meta line — "Naming your triggers" / "Lesson 5 · Week II" at left 32, top 190 and 220
findings.property: which lesson the card shows (selection rule)
findings.design: Lesson 5 · Week II, with four of the week's rail filled — the same account the family numbers Day 41
findings.app: "Choose Your Action" / "Lesson 6 · Week VI", four filled. src/app/(app)/today.tsx:111 does `const dayLesson = lessonForDay(day)` with day = 41
findings.note: The implementer and specs/53-today-p2.md both write this off as "the canvas contradicts itself: Day 41 is Week VI". Under a progress reading the canvas is self-consistent and the app matches none of it. Evidence: (a) scripts/uifinal1/seed.mjs:122 marks exactly day-08…day-11 complete — week II's first four — so the next incomplete lesson is day 12, which weekFor/indexInWeek render as literally "Lesson 5 · Week II"; (b) the same account's Score Detail Moves credits "Lessons +12", i.e. 4 lessons × 3 points, which is the same four; (c) the canvas's rail is 4-of-N filled, which is the count of completed lessons in that week. So "first incomplete lesson" reproduces the frame's meta line character for character and its rail fill exactly, while `lessonForDay(day)` reproduces neither. The title itself ("Naming your triggers") is mock — it appears nowhere in the bundle except these two frames — but the meta line and the fill are reproducible and currently are not reproduced. This is a behaviour call the app is entitled to make, which is why it is `likely` and not `certain`; it should at least be a numbered decision in this run's log rather than an unexamined inheritance of prior-run D-112.

findings.frame: #59 Today Home II / #60 Today Home Task
findings.element: the week rail at the foot of the This week card (left 20, right 20, bottom 20, gap 7, 4.5 tall, radius 2.5)
findings.property: segment count, segment width and pitch
findings.design: 6 segments, 49 wide, at x 32 · 88 · 144 · 200 · 256 · 312 (pitch 56); first four #131313, last two rgba(19,19,19,0.15)
findings.note: Confirmed in both signatures and visible in the side-by-side crop. Not one of the two D015 wash equivalences. The deviation is defensible — curriculum84 runs seven lessons a week and D084 records that the week boards draw seven rows, so a six-slot rail could never fill — but it is a real, visible difference on two frames and it is the only element of the card whose geometry does not pair. It is also undocumented in this run: src/app/(app)/today.tsx:450 cites "DECISIONS D-112", a number that exists only in prior-runs/UI_FINAL/DECISIONS.md:1163. This run's DECISIONS.md has no entry for it, and the implementer's own D063–D065 additions did not add one.

findings.element: the whole page-two composition — a day-41 "This week" card above the generic task card (phone-in-the-drawer art, crescent glyph, "Today’s task", the sentence at top 194 in 18/600/26/−0.1)
findings.property: reachability of the state the frame draws
findings.design: "Naming your triggers · Lesson 5 · Week II" with four rail segments filled, above the generic phone-in-a-drawer task card
findings.app: unreachable as one screen. today.tsx:113–117 chooses the task register from `dayLesson`, so any day that has a lesson takes the lesson-sourced register (#60) and the generic one is only reached past day 84. The capture recipe therefore drives the account to day 86, where the same page draws "Start the first lesson · Week I" with an all-empty seven-slot rail
findings.note: So frame #59's task card was verified (it matches — I cropped it and read it, the art, label, ring and sentence all pair) but its lesson card was verified only via #60, at a different account, and the frame's own combination cannot be produced at all. The one register reachable at day 41 that yields the label "Today’s task" is a hand-named `dailyAction` from the night check-in, and that path draws `NoteArt`, not the frame's phone-in-the-drawer (`PhoneDownArt`). The report presented the day-86 capture as if it verified the frame; it verifies half of it.

findings.element: the footer card's subtitle "vs Apr 3 – May 3" (80, 732.5) and the chart's month labels "May" / "Jun" / "Jul" (40, 178, 314 at y 632)
findings.property: date format — component order and month abbreviation
findings.app: "vs 27 Jul – 5 Sept"; axis "Jul", "Aug", "Sept" (day-then-month, four-letter "Sept"). src/app/score.tsx:608 `monthDay()` and :388 the axis label both call `toLocaleDateString(undefined, …)`, so the format follows the device locale — the capture host is en_GB
findings.note: The report listed "vs Apr 3 – May 3" among values that are "a template or a datum", which understates it: the values are data but the ORDER and the abbreviation are formatting, and the canvas states one form. Only an en-US device reproduces the canvas. Two consequences: the screen does not match the frame for a large share of users, and every capture taken on this host renders these strings in a form no frame draws, which is a trap for the next pass. Passing an explicit locale (or formatting the parts by hand) makes it deterministic.

findings.element: the chart's y axis (labels at left 16, y 416 / 480 / 546 / 605) and the plotted curve
findings.note: Genuinely unmatchable, and the report's reasoning checks out: SCORE_BASE is 1,000, so no account this app can hold produces an 800 floor. Everything around it does pair exactly — the two month gridlines at x 150 and 282 (y 438, 184 tall), the dashed current-value rule 341 wide from x 52, the right-hand dashed rule at x 352 (y 426, 196 tall), the plot path box at x 56 width 296, the marker circles at x 343 / 347.5 and the value badge at x 321.3 width 61.3 with its 0 6 14 rgba(19,19,19,0.22) shadow. Only the y coordinates inside the plot move, and they move with the data.

findings.element: the five ledger rows — Clean days / Check-ins / Lessons / Urges ridden / Slip · Jul 8 — and the footer's "+86 net"
findings.note: A verification-coverage gap rather than a proven app defect, and the report closed it too quickly by grouping it with the unmatchable axis. Nothing about SCORE_BASE blocks these: the numbers are 16 clean days, 9 check-ins, 4 lessons, 4 urges ridden and 1 slip, all seedable, and the seed already reproduces other parts of this same account exactly — the total 1,240, the delta 18, the lessons row +12, and the Last-30-days dot pattern on Today Home (three white days at the same three indices as the canvas, gold ring on the last dot). Only the lessons row currently matches. I did separately verify the thing that is app logic rather than data: the bar-width rule. Fitting the app's own widths gives w = 19.5 + (150 − 19.5)·|v|/max, and evaluating that against the canvas's max of 64 gives 150 / 56.2 / 44.0 / 35.8 / 52.1 against the frame's 150 / 58 / 44 / 34 / 52 — within 2pt on every bar. So the renderer is right and only the inputs differ.

But it is worth stating plainly what it costs on this frame: 22pt of white card below the canvas's own card edge, which is 33,845 of the frame's 64,692 differing pixels — over half the whole-frame diff, and it is not mentioned in the report's #60 entry, which called that frame "verified, no change needed". The residual is content length, not geometry.

unreachable: #59 Today Home II — captured, but not in the state the frame draws. The frame composes a day-41 lesson card ("Naming your triggers · Lesson 5 · Week II", four rail segments filled) above the generic task card (phone-in-the-drawer, crescent, "Today’s task"). In the app those two are mutually exclusive: today.tsx:113-117 takes the lesson-sourced task register whenever the day has a lesson, so the generic register is only reached past day 84, where the lesson card degrades to "Start the first lesson · Week I" with an empty rail. I tried the day-41 hand-named `dailyAction` register, which does give the label "Today’s task" at day 41, but it draws NoteArt rather than the frame's PhoneDownArt. Captured at day 86 (which verifies the task card) and relied on #60's capture for the lesson card.
